content:
Apple today released the watchOS 27.0.1 update for Apple Watch. The company says this update fixes an issue where some Apple Watch devices would unexpectedly restart. The update is only available for Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users.

Here are the full release notes for watchOS 27.0.1:

On Reddit and other forums, some Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users have reported that their new watches restart unexpectedly several times a day. While not all users are affected, there is clearly an issue, and hopefully this software update will resolve it.

Has your Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4 experienced any issues? Feel free to share with us in the comments.
